title: Storm-Water Runoff Coefficients vs. Surface
description: Storm-water runoff coefficients for various surfaces. Reference table showing typical runoff coefficient ranges for different surface types used in stormwater management calculations.

components.content:
## Usage

Storm-water runoff coefficients are used to estimate the volume of runoff generated from a given rainfall event. The coefficient varies based on the surface type and its permeability.

**Key Points:**
- Lower coefficients (lawns, gardens) indicate high infiltration and less runoff
- Higher coefficients (asphalt, roofs) indicate low infiltration and more runoff
- Use these values in the rational method formula: Q = C × I × A
  - Q = Peak runoff (m³/s or similar)
  - C = Runoff coefficient
  - I = Rainfall intensity
  - A = Drainage area
